**Shellforge does not handle pull requests.** This one will be closed without review.

To propose a change, open a [change request](https://github.com/NathanGel/shellforge/issues/new/choose)
instead — a link to this branch is welcome there as background. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/NathanGel/shellforge/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
